property_summary: Only the owner (address 0, the default _contractOwner) can call setApprovedLogger; for any logger L != address(0), owner-approved L must become an approved logger (approvedToLog(L)==true) while the owner's own key remains unapproved (approvedToLog(owner)==false) — the mutant writes msg.sender's key instead, leaving L unapproved and wrongly approving the owner.
change_summary: Write to msg.sender's key instead of _logger's key.
